main_text.l: veteres de verbi iftius ufu & multi-
plici notione bene monuerunt, in me-
moria habuiffent. Non enim id quif-
quod sciam ; certas linguas certis po-
pulis aut coeli plagis ita naturales esse,
aliud, quod ejufdem fit generis : sed
nus, in varias spargi terras, in diversos
ex antiquis sedibus exturbari vi ; alios
in locum succedere : haec & similia non
esse quod miremur, cum ita sint homi-
nes, & ita ferat natura rerum, ut ista
vulgo fiant : ita & linguarum inter ho-
liquis ipsum fortasse malit dicere, quia
sive mutatione sive duratione nihil fit

page.notes: Marginal marks at right (small numerals/signs, e.g. "15", "4 9" with a stroke) are not transcribed as text. Small word "ipsum" and "natura" are italic in the original; the first italic word reads as "ipsum"/"ufum" and is uncertain. Words near the left edge were partially damaged.
